name: Pythia staking reward re-claim
summary: claimRewards() paid out against the caller's current staking-token balance without settling or resetting reward accounting when that balance was transferred, so the attacker recycled the same stake through fresh helper contracts and claimed the reward pool ~30 times in one transaction.
